entries.title: A lantern for the dungeon, and something waiting at the bottom
items: The dungeon is much darker now. Most of the torches have burnt out, and you can hardly see without a light
An old oil lantern hangs on a hook on the way down the spiral stairs. Press G to take it and carry it in your hand, with an oil gauge in the corner. G at the hook again fills it up
Keep an eye on the flame. Old lanterns sputter… and sometimes they go out
On 12 December something big happens down in the cauldron chamber. Bring the lantern

entries.title: High scores at Bowlinghallen
items: A big lit HIGH SCORES board on the back wall above the pins, with chasing bulbs and a pink neon glow. It shows the top 10: name, score and date
Finish a game good enough for the top 10 and you get a NEW HIGH SCORE! splash, a fanfare and a flashing board, then type your name (or tap CHRIS / MARTIN)
The game remembers the last name you typed
Marius gets a message on his phone about every finished bowling game, and the best scores are added to the board for everyone

entries.title: Chris's flat, the noise challenge and the dungeon
items: Chris's flat furnished for real: kitchen, sofa with cushions, TV with fireplace channel, dining table, bathroom, a new bedroom, advent stars, candle arch, a decorated tree and stockings
NOISE CHALLENGE: G at the 'Chores for today' note on the fridge. Hold G at each chore (washing, vacuuming, dishes, music, frying an egg) without the noise meter reaching 100%. 3 minutes, +200 kr

The witch's DUNGEON: a spiral stair from her flat down to a corridor, cauldron chamber, jar room, crawl-space and bone room, 9–12 m underground. She appears behind you, drops from above and whispers in the dark
The dungeon is hidden until 8 December in the real game (open on Marius's Mac for building). No digging in her flat or under the house

entries.title: Bowlinghallen comes alive
items: Staff: Stine (films), Geir (snack bar), Arild (shoe desk); 9 customers on the settees, at the arcade, the pool table and the film racks
Bowling: G on a lane (50 kr). Space locks aim, Space throws, hold A/D to curve. Real pins, 10-frame scoring, STRIKE/SPARE
Other people bowling on lanes 1, 4 and 5, with their own scores
Video racks: 178 films from the 80s to 2005 in 9 genres. Rent for 39 kr
Arcade: SNAKE, BREAKOUT and SAURON INVADERS (the Eye is the boss every 3rd wave). 5 kr a credit, top-5 high scores
Pool: 8-ball against Geir or trick-shot practice
Air hockey against the staff, first to 7

entries.title: Num num num
items: Near the witch's house you'll sometimes hear her eating: 'Num num num num num… Mmm, so crunchy.' (Nobody knows what yet.)

entries.title: Dev panel: walls & windows
items: New first tab WALLS & WINDOWS
Slim walls (12 cm) in 1, 2, 3 and 4 m, normal (2 m, fits one floor) or tall (3 m); any colour
Wall with window, double window, lit window, glass wall, half wall / bar, doorway, wide opening
Walls with a door (wood, white or glass) that swings open when you walk up
Windows to put into a block wall: square, double, tall, panorama, round, lit; doors and double glass doors (remove the blocks first, then place it in the hole)
Slim walls block you like real walls; doors and openings let you through

entries.title: Two races
items: JETPACK RINGS: start by the river south of Stjerneporten (search T: 'Jetpack rings (start)'). 20 rings over the river, under the bridge and up to the cairn on Nonskarknuten. Each ring +2 s fuel. Win: medal, kroner, the Elytra and 64 rockets, then jump off and fly
SPARK RACE: top of Hamrevegen by the Hamre barns down to the roundabout, 1.7 km (search 'Spark race: Hamrevegen'). W kicks, A/D steer, S brakes, Shift/Space drift. Race Oddvar, Sigrid and Tor-Arne
The Eye can't hurt you during a race

entries.title: The Night Wing
items: A one-of-a-kind armoured flying car, parked on the square next to where you start
G to get in. On the ground it drives like a car
Space (or ↑) launches it on rockets: wings fold out and it flies
In the air: W/S throttle, A/D turn and bank, Space/↑ climb, C/↓ dive, Shift afterburner
Come in low and slow to land; the wings fold back in
G always gets you into a car you're standing next to

entries.title: The witch hates Christmas
items: 18 new lines: she hates Christmas, bans all Christmas lights and swears she'll tear them down
12 new threats: lawyers, the police, 'If this were America, I'd sue', 'You better watch out, young man'
8 new notes in Chris's mailbox and under the door
Test links (?at=) never drop you inside a building any more

entries.title: Wider, real Bowlinghallen
items: Bowlinghallen built from your own design: 5 lanes, VHS racks, arcade, pool table, WC, café
Glass double door that swings open on the side entrance, with the BOWLINGHALLEN sign above it
Second sign facing Åmotsvegen
90s music inside the hall

entries.title: Market vendors and spawn
items: A stall-keeper at each of the 4 market stalls on the square, with things to buy (G)
You now start and respawn on the square
Dev panel: SET SPAWN HERE button

entries.title: Dev panel: more tools
items: Eyedropper: I or middle-click copies whatever is under the cursor
20 new Christmas lights: strings, street garlands, icicles, roofline bulbs, curtains, arches, light trees, globes, reindeer
TV tower (60 m and 100 m)
Mailbox and the real mailbox stand at Krågehølen

entries.title: Chris's place
items: Chris's mailbox: look at it to see new letters, G to read notes from Downstairs
Wreaths removed from shop doors
Gutted the brick building at Hageteigen: one big open hall

entries.title: Sky and screen
items: Clouds you can fly through
On-screen clock
Clean film mode: H hides absolutely everything

entries.title: 17 town details
items: Parked cars in car parks (and no more buried cars)
Snow banks, road poles, bus stops and a bus, crossings and signs, bins, benches, bike racks
Candle arches and paper stars in house windows, julenek and nisse on the square
People with kick-sleds, prams and dogs, sledding kids, snowmen, chimney smoke
Church bells on the hour, playgrounds, icy river edges with reeds and boats
Sounds: snow crunch, passing cars, river, distant dogs, shop doorbells

entries.title: Fixes and new things
items: No more getting stuck on the ground or in midair
Extra: real entrance, floor and ceiling
Martin's tennis court in the right place
White, wider bridge (Stjerneporten) with green panels
Eye on/off button in Movie mode
Jetpack in your inventory (slot 5)
Dev panel for editing the world
